preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 20) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for n in [int(line.split()[0])] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10) representing the length of the sequence.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**5 <= a_i <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a_i in [int(x) for x in line.split()[1:]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains n integers a_i (-10^5 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^5) representing the sequence.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n + 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n + 1 integers in its two lines (1 for n, n for a_i).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line == 'YES') == any(all(any((a_i == b_j - b_k) for b_j in b_sequence) for a_i in a_sequence) for b_sequence in possible_b_sequences(a_sequence)) for a_sequence, stdout_line in zip(test_cases, stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if and only if there exists a sequence b_1, ..., b_n such that for every a_i in the input sequence, there exist indices j and k (1 ≤ j, k ≤ n) where a_i = b_j - b_k. The output 'NO' means no such sequence exists.
